data.context: In the 2024 report *Computer Implemented Inventions: Patent Trends at IP Australia, EPO and USPTO*, Appendix Table A4 reports USPTO patent application counts by filing year for 2001–2020, grouped as CII-PSM-likely-clear, CII-PSM-likely-adverse, and non-CII. The categories use machine-learning predictions about whether IP Australia examiners would object to computer implemented inventions on patentable-subject-matter grounds.
